title: Maximum Total Subarray Value I
explanation:
* Intuition: This problem can be solved by iterating over all possible subarrays and calculating their values. The maximum total value will be achieved when we choose the subarray with the maximum difference between its maximum and minimum elements, and we choose it k times.
* Approach: 
  1. Initialize the result as 0.
  2. Iterate over all possible subarrays.
  3. For each subarray, calculate its maximum and minimum elements.
  4. Calculate the value of the subarray by subtracting the minimum element from the maximum element.
  5. Update the result with the maximum value that can be achieved by choosing the current subarray k times.
  6. Return the result.
* Time Complexity: O(n^2) because we are using two nested loops to iterate over all possible subarrays.
* Space Complexity: O(1) because we are using a constant amount of space to store the result and the maximum and minimum elements of the current subarray.
